subject: Priority GPU classification change and commit adjustment — BrightLayer
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: BrightLayer — request: priority GPU classification change + commit adjustment

Kimberly / team,

Quick summary from the BrightLayer call this morning: they want to change their reserved GPU family for the upcoming quarter. Current commitment: H100 family reserved (steady-state). Their engineering team ran a compatibility validation and believes the model shard layout would run more efficiently on an A100 variant for now while they finish a model refactor. They want two items:

- A prioritized reclassification from H100 to A100 for the next 30–45 days (they asked for a reservation hold while they migrate).
- A short-term adjustment to committed units for Q2 (reduce H100 commit and convert equivalent units to A100), plus a temporary overage rate concession while they run mixed hardware.

They've asked for specific economics: a 25% reduction in overage rate for first 60 days and a one-time 15% credit on the migration month if we can accommodate the swap with priority placement. Procurement asked for a written term-sheet and a DocuSign-ready file.

I've attached their request PDF and a quick impact worksheet (first cut). Can we get an approval or list of constraints we should pass back?

Thanks,
Aditya
--
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLayer — request: priority GPU classification change + commit adjustment

Karthik / Lauren — looping you in for an exec signoff.

Proposal to approve with guardrails:

- Approve temporary reclassification: allow BrightLayer to run A100 equivalent capacity for up to 45 days while they migrate. Reservation hold: we mark existing H100 slots as "in-migration" and prioritize their jobs to A100 pool.
- Economics: grant 25% discount on published overage rates for the first 45 days (rather than 60) and apply a one-time credit equal to 10% of the monthly reserved cost to smooth billing impact.
- Commit adjustment: allow a non-cancellable term amendment to reflect the temporary unit change; revert to original H100 commitment after 45 days unless they sign a revised commit.

Conditions: we require a signed addendum (term sheet) before any reclassification, and legal has to confirm stop-gap liability language for performance variance. Finance needs to sign off on the credit magnitude (I flagged it as $72k gross impact in the attached estimate).

If approved I will have Aditya send the term-sheet to BrightLayer and attach DocuSign. If you want a tighter or looser concession, tell me — we can tighten the discount window or reduce the credit.

-Kim

Kimberly Park
Senior Enterprise Account Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-05-05T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightLayer — request: priority GPU classification change + commit adjustment

Kim — thanks for the write-up. A couple of quick operational/financial notes before we sign off:

1) Capacity: We can prioritize the A100 pool for them, but that creates potential scheduling churn for other reserved customers; need to ensure it doesn't violate existing SLAs. Ops flagged this as low risk if we limit the migration window to <=45 days.
2) Financials: The $72k estimate looks right for the credit/discount combo as-is. Approve from a deal-desk perspective if Finance accepts the amortization across Q2. I'd prefer the discount window to be 45 days (agree with Kim).
3) Contingency: Require a clause that allows Redwood to auto-fallback them back to H100 if A100 preempt capacity drops below X% for two consecutive days. This protects supply.

Attach: impact-estimate-9421.xlsx (I pulled monthly burn scenarios).

Karthik
Director, Deal Desk Operations
Redwood Inference

Kim / team — approved with a small modification.

Decision: APPROVE the A100 reclassification and reservation hold, with the following terms:

- Reservation hold / priority placement: up to 45 days. Ops to implement the in-migration marker and add a fallback policy to auto-revert to H100 if A100 availability drops below the agreed threshold.
- Overages: 25% discount on overage rates for the first 45 days.
- One-time migration credit: approve 12% of one month’s committed cost (reduced from proposed 15%). Finance will absorb the remainder; please reflect this as a one-line credit on the first post-migration invoice.
- Legal: expedite redline of the short addendum (updated-term-sheet-9421.pdf). Aditya, send the DocuSign link to BrightLayer once Legal confirms.

Please ensure HubSpot deal RDW-DEAL-9421 is updated with the amended commit and the DocuSign link. Once signed, Ops should schedule the migration window and notify affected internal customers per the standard change-control.

Thanks — and good catch on the contingency language. Approve as long as Legal and Finance are looped.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
